label: Archaeology of Reading
description: A unique corpus of curated digitized images of early modern books with significant annotations from contemporary scholars such as Gabriel Harvey. The collection offers users a range of opportunities to explore and mine these notes, compare marginalia across books, and thus reconstruct Early Modern reading strategies.
